templates.title: Sign-in successful
templates.description: Notifies user of a successful sign-in to their account.

channels.name: in_app
channels.title: Signed in from a new device
channels.body: Hi {{userName}}, we detected a sign-in to your account from {{device}} at {{location}} on {{time}}.

channels.name: email
channels.subject: New sign-in to your account
channels.body:
Hi {{userName}},

We noticed a sign-in to your account from {{device}} at {{location}} on {{time}}. If this was you, no action is required. If you don't recognize this activity, please secure your account immediately.
channels.bodyHtml:
Hi {{userName}},

We noticed a sign-in to your account from {{device}} at {{location}} on {{time}}.

If this was you, no action is required. If you don't recognize this activity, secure your account immediately.

device.description: Device or client used for sign-in

templates.title: Password reset request
templates.description: One-time password reset instructions for users who requested a reset.

channels.name: email
channels.subject: Reset your password
channels.body:
Hi {{userName}},

We received a request to reset your password. Use the link below to set a new password. This link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes.

{{resetUrl}}

If you did not request a password reset, ignore this email or contact support.
channels.bodyHtml:
Hi {{userName}},

We received a request to reset your password. Use the link below to set a new password. This link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes.

Reset your password

If you did not request a password reset, ignore this email or contact support.

channels.name: in_app
channels.title: Password reset requested
channels.body: A password reset was requested for your account. Use the link sent to your email to complete the reset.

templates.title: User mention

channels.name: email

{{actorName}} mentioned you in {{contextTitle}}.

{{excerpt}}

View the conversation

channels.title: Order confirmed
channels.body: Your order {{orderId}} was confirmed. Total: {{orderTotal}}. Tap to view details.
